anya: Heads-up  onboarding friction: quickstart curl example breaks on PowerShell (single quotes prevent $REDWOOD_API_KEY expansion), Go sample reads REDWOOD_LEGACY_KEY, and quickstart implies SDK retries are on but Node defaults to off. Getting support tickets.

matt: Repro'd in pwsh. Example fails. I'll update README with both POSIX and PowerShell curl snippets and switch Go to REDWOOD_API_KEY.

lia: I'll add the PowerShell snippet to onboarding email templates.

sam: Docs should explicitly state SDK retry defaults (Node: off, Python: 3, Go: 2) and link to a new "SDK retry policies" page.

anya: Action items: 1) add POSIX + pwsh curl variants, 2) standardize env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY + changelog note for legacy var, 3) add retry defaults to troubleshooting.

devex-bot: Created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/2710 and draft PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/401 (assigned to @matt).

matt: I'll push the PR today and ping support after merge. :thumbsup:
